name: SDLC
description: Engineering practice run with the human rather than recited at them. The execute loop agrees the outcome, the architecture decisions, a module map and every story's acceptance criteria with the user once, then runs one story or a whole epic unattended through failing tests, a build subagent, a three-pass review, the full suite and a pull request, choosing each next story from what is ready and pausing only for a new story, a forced decision, a product decision or the merge. Around it: orient, feature, story, next-story, spike, greenfield, give-feedback, harness and adr. The user, not the model, makes every judgment call.
